meta.title: From Activation to Advocacy
meta.subtitle: Three of fourteen touchpoints are live today — the rest is the roadmap.

touchpoints.label: Verification Nudge
touchpoints.description: Platform-split reminder (iOS/Android/other) to finish licence upload and ID verification.

touchpoints.label: First-Trip Incentive
touchpoints.description: €10-off push once verified, encouraging the first booking within the critical activation window.

touchpoints.label: Abandoned Booking
touchpoints.description: GoCar's equivalent of cart abandonment — someone starts but doesn't complete a booking. No automation exists today.

touchpoints.label: Browse / Search Reminder
touchpoints.description: Nudge for people who searched availability but didn't book — not currently captured or actioned.

touchpoints.label: First Trip Booked
touchpoints.description: Event-triggered confirmation the moment a first booking is completed.

touchpoints.label: 2nd-Booking Nurture
touchpoints.description: Encourage a second, different use case after the first trip. Not yet built.

touchpoints.label: Occasion Reminder
touchpoints.description: Need-based triggers — moving season, DIY projects, holiday weekends — matching GoCar's occasion-driven usage pattern.

touchpoints.label: Review / NPS Request
touchpoints.description: Live, branching flow already asking for feedback shortly after a trip.

touchpoints.label: Loyalty Points Reminder
touchpoints.description: GoCar's loyalty programme (79% satisfaction, 3k monthly users) has no lifecycle automation behind it today.

touchpoints.label: Birthday / Anniversary
touchpoints.description: No date-based personal milestone flow currently exists.

touchpoints.label: Use-Case Expansion
touchpoints.description: Cross-use-case discovery — e.g. someone who's only moved house tries a day trip.

touchpoints.label: Predictive Recommendations
touchpoints.description: Salesforce Predictive Intelligence attributes exist in the account but appear dormant — a real, already-paid-for capability going unused.

touchpoints.label: Referral / Ambassador
touchpoints.description: No structured referral or ambassador programme for top riders.

touchpoints.label: Winback
touchpoints.description: Reactivation journey exists in Salesforce Marketing Cloud but sits in Draft — never activated.
